name: unirate-exchange-rates
title: UniRate Currency Exchange Rates & EU VAT Rates
description: A regularly-updated open dataset of foreign-exchange rates for 885+ currencies (fiat + crypto) against USD, EUR and GBP, plus standard EU VAT rates. Sourced from the free UniRate API (https://unirateapi.com).

licenses.name: ODC-PDDL-1.0
licenses.title: Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License 1.0

sources.title: UniRate API — free currency exchange rate & VAT API

resources.name: exchange-rates
resources.title: Foreign exchange rates (USD, EUR, GBP bases)
resources.description: Long-format exchange rates: one row per (base, currency). `rate` is the value of 1 unit of `base` expressed in `currency`.

fields.name: date
fields.description: UTC date the snapshot was generated (ISO-8601).

fields.name: base
fields.description: Base currency code (USD, EUR or GBP).

fields.name: currency
fields.description: Quote currency code (ISO 4217 or crypto ticker).

resources.name: eu-vat-rates
resources.title: Standard EU VAT rates
resources.description: Standard value-added-tax rate per EU member state.

fields.name: date
fields.description: UTC date the snapshot was generated (ISO-8601).

fields.name: country_code
fields.description: Country code (EU VAT convention; EL = Greece, UK = United Kingdom).
